evidence: Homepage shows 6 template cards each listing title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title (Professional Resume), author (Sarah Chen), description, category (Resume), scenario (Business), usage count (1,250 uses), and update date (Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template opens a dialog with template details (title, description, author, uses) and a Fill Template form with all fields.
Dialog shows 'Required fields missing' banner listing all missing required field names, and Preview Result tab is disabled while fields are empty.
Preview Result tab is disabled when required fields are empty; will re-verify it becomes enabled once fields are validly filled.
All 13 fields (12 required + Phone/End Date optional) accepted typed values as shown in the Fill Template tab.
After filling required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and clicking it shows the generated resume with all entered values substituted.

Preview shows rendered Markdown: H1 heading (name), H2 headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), H3 subheading, bold (strong) text, italic (emphasis) date range, and a separator/horizontal rule all rendered correctly with all placeholders replaced.
Markdown template rendered proper headings, bold, italics, and separator after field substitution.
Generated preview contains no unresolved placeholders (e.g. no {{field}} tokens remain); all declared fields mapped correctly into the content.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard showed a toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.' and the button changed to 'Copied!'.
Clicking the heart icon in the template dialog immediately activated it and updated the header 'Favorites' button badge count from none to '1'.

Favorited two templates (heart icon in dialog and on card); header 'Favorites' badge updated to 2; clicking Favorites button switched to a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 2 of 6 templates' with only the favorited cards.
While in favorites-only view, typing 'Resume' in the search box narrowed the favorites list from 2 to 1 (Showing 1 of 6 templates), showing only Professional Resume.

Category filter (Resume) narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6; Sort By offers Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical - selecting Alphabetical reordered cards to A,M,P,P,P,W order correctly.
Search, category filter, scenario filter, favorites-only toggle, and sort selection all updated visible cards and 'Showing X of 6 templates' count instantly without any page navigation/reload.

actual: Searching 'Resme' or 'Reusme' (minor typo/transposition of 'Resume') returns 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' and 'No templates found' instead of matching the Professional Resume template. Search appears to use plain substring matching with no fuzzy/typo tolerance.

evidence: Typing 'Re' (2 chars) showed a real-time suggestion dropdown with matching template/field names; clicking 'Professional Resume' suggestion filled the search box with that text and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Entering 'not-an-email' (invalid email format) into the required Email field did not block the Preview tab or show a validation error; Preview Result tab became enabled and the generated preview embedded the invalid text verbatim ('| not-an-email |').

evidence: Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank showed toast 'Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields.' and dialog remained open without submitting.

issue: Custom template submission does not validate field/placeholder mapping
actual: Submitted a custom template whose content used {{recipientName}} and {{senderName}} placeholders while the defined fields auto-generated keys {{recipient_name}} and {{sender_name}} (label-to-key conversion mismatch). The app allowed submission ('Template submitted!') without any mismatch error. Using the resulting template and filling all fields produced a preview containing unresolved literal placeholders: 'Dear {{recipientName}},' and 'Best, {{senderName}}'.

evidence: Submit Template dialog allows entering title, description, author, category, scenario, Markdown content, and defining multiple custom fields (label, placeholder, type, required) via Add Field before submitting.

After submitting, toast 'Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library' appeared, library count increased to 7 of 7, and the new 'Quick Thank You Note' card appeared and was selectable via Use Template, opening its fill form.
Submitting the custom template immediately updated 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and displayed the new card in the grid without any page reload.

issue: Duplicate field labels not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Adding two fields both labeled 'Name' (both generating key {{name}}) was allowed without any warning; the app then allowed the template with duplicate fields to be submitted successfully ('Template submitted!'), instead of rejecting or disambiguating the duplicate before submission.

issue: Markdown-breaking special characters not neutralized in field values
actual: The app blocks only a specific character set (< > { } [ ] \ | `) with an inline error ('Special characters ... are not allowed'), but does NOT block or escape Markdown-syntax characters like ** and #. Entering '**Bold** # Heading text' into the Full Name field was accepted (no validation error, Preview tab enabled), and the generated Preview rendered it as literal Markdown: an H1 heading '# Heading text' with 'Bold' rendered in actual bold text, corrupting the intended document structure instead of treating the field value as plain text.

evidence: After navigating to http://localhost:6089/ again (full reload), the Favorites badge still shows '2' and the library still shows 'Showing 8 of 8 templates', including both previously-submitted custom templates ('Duplicate Field Test' and 'Quick Thank You Note') with their original data intact, confirming favorites and custom templates persist across a reload in the same browser (likely via localStorage).
